hook.text: "I am abundant" for 3 weeks. Your brain said no.
hook.query: woman sitting alone by window morning light

beats.text: You said it every morning. Out loud. Exactly like the videos told you to.
And every time, a quiet voice answered: no I'm not.
That voice isn't negative. It just can't find your life anywhere in that sentence.
beats.query: hands holding coffee cup on table

beats.text: An affirmation sticks when it names something real. One thing you'll do, and the day you'll do it by.
beats.query: hand writing in notebook close up

beats.text: Not "I am abundant." Try: "I send the three applications I've been avoiding. Before Friday."
